## Kia VPN RELEASE_TAG

Kia VPN is a rebranded build of the open-source [Hiddify app](https://github.com/hiddify/hiddify-app) (GPLv3 + Hiddify extended terms, see [LICENSE.md](https://github.com/kiagram/kia-vpn/blob/main/LICENSE.md)). Built by GitHub Actions from this repository.

| OS | File |
|----|------|
| Android (recommended) | `KiaVPN-Android-universal.apk` (or `-arm64` / `-arm7` / `-x86_64`) |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `KiaVPN-Windows-Setup-x64.exe` (installer) or `KiaVPN-Windows-Portable-x64.zip` |
| macOS (universal) | `KiaVPN-MacOS.dmg` or `KiaVPN-MacOS-Installer.pkg` (unsigned: right-click → Open the first time) |

**How to use:** install → tap **+** → *Add from clipboard* (or scan QR) with your private subscription link → Connect. The best working server is selected automatically.

<div dir="rtl">

**راهنما:** برنامه را نصب کنید ← دکمه‌ی **+** ← «افزودن از کلیپ‌بورد» (یا اسکن QR) با لینک اشتراک شخصی خودتان ← اتصال. بهترین سرور به‌صورت خودکار انتخاب می‌شود.

</div>
